name: facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources/preprocessing/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.run_preprocessing_pipeline: run the code preprocessing pipeline on a source code folder with BPE tokenization and binarization
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.preprocess_dataset_for_training: preprocess a monolingual functions dataset by extracting, tokenizing, splitting, and binarizing source code
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.apply_fastbpe_tokenization: apply fastBPE tokenization to source code files in multiple programming languages like Python, Java, and C++
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.train_bpe_codes: train BPE codes on source code data with a configurable number of merge operations
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.binarize_dataset: binarize tokenized source code data and create vocabulary files for XLM model training

facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.use_timeout_decorator: use the timeout decorator to limit a function's execution to a specified number of seconds
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.raise_timeout_error: raise a TimeoutError exception when a decorated function exceeds its allotted execution time
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.nest_timeout_decorators: nest multiple timeout decorators on the same function to support layered timeout constraints
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.customize_timeout_message: customize the timeout error message by passing a custom error_message string to the decorator
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.review_timeout_handler: review the timeout decorator's SIGALRM signal handler logic for nested timer preservation and restoration

facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.parse_bool_flag: parse a command line boolean flag string like true false on off or 1 0
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.validate_file: check if a given file path exists and has a non-zero file size
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.count_lines: count the number of lines in a file using the wc command
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.shuffle_parallel_files: shuffle multiple parallel files in the same random order and write shuffled outputs
facebookresearch_codegen/codegen_sources.split_arguments: split a comma-separated argument string respecting parentheses nesting and quoted strings
